source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of stereoisomerism and optical isomerism (PDF 52-54).

blocks.text: Stereoisomers do qism ke hain: optical isomers aur cis-trans isomers (agla topic). Optical isomers ki tabeei aur kimiyai khasiyatein aik jaisi hain siwaye plane-polarised roshni ko ghumane ki salahiyat ke. Aise isomers optically active hain, aur polarisation ke plane ka ghoomna optical activity hai. Agar compound plane ko daen (ghari ki simt) ghumaye to dextrorotatory, (+) se, aur baen (ghari ke ulat) ghumaye to laevorotatory, (-) se zahir hota hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein: polarimeter
blocks.text: Polarimeter optical activity ka pata lagata aur napta hai. Aik wavelength wali (monochromatic) roshni polariser se guzar kar aik plane mein thartharati hai, phir compound ke mehlool se guzarti hai. Agar plane ghoom jaye to compound optically active hai; warna optically inactive.

blocks.alt: Unpolarised roshni (har simt mein teeron wala daira) polarizer (patli khari jhiri wala daira) se guzar kar PPL (aik khare dohre teer wala daira) banti hai, phir Sample likhe dabbe se guzarti hai. Sample se do teer nikalte hain: aik daire ki taraf jahan dashed dohra teer khare rukh se ghari ki simt mein ghooma hai aur ghari ki simt ka mura teer hai (Dextrorotatory), aur doosra jahan yeh ghari ke ulat ghooma hai aur ulta mura teer hai (Levorotatory).
blocks.caption: Figure 19.4: PPL ki optical rotation (kitab ki Figure 19.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khari seedhi teer wala plane PPL ka asal plane hai. Optically active sample se guzar kar plane ghoom jata hai; dashed teer naya plane hai. Ghari ki simt (daen) ghoome to compound dextrorotatory, (+), hai; ghari ke ulat (baen) ghoome to levorotatory, (-). Mure teer ghoomne ki simt dikhate hain.

Optical activity ki bunyadi shart yeh hai ke molecule apni aaina shakal par poora na baithe. Hamare baen aur daen haath rozmarra ki misal hain: yeh aik doosre ki aaina shakal hain lekin aik ko doosre par bilkul nahi rakha ja sakta. Lafz chiral Yunani cheir, yani haath, se hai, is liye chirality ko handedness bhi kehte hain. Jo molecules apni aaina shakal par baith jayein woh achiral aur optically inactive hain.

blocks.alt: Baayan haath (hatheli dekhne wale ki taraf, angootha daen), aaina, aur daayan haath (angootha baen) us ki aaina shakal; phir dono haath aik doosre par rakhe hue, 'nonsuperimposable' likha, angoothe ulti simton mein.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.5: Hamare haath apni aaina shakal par poore nahi baithte (kitab ki Figure 19.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baayan haath aaine mein daayan haath nazar aata hai, magar dono ko aik doosre par rakhein to angoothe ulti taraf rehte hain; yeh poore nahi baithte (non-superimposable). Isi ko chirality ya handedness kehte hain (Yunani 'cheir' yani haath). Jis carbon par chaar mukhtalif groups hon woh molecule ko isi tarah chiral bana deta hai.

blocks.title: Chiral carbon
blocks.text: Chiral (asymmetric) carbon woh carbon atom hai jo chaar mukhtalif atoms ya groups se jura ho. Sirf aik chiral carbon wala molecule hamesha chiral aur optically active hota hai; aik se zyada wala ho bhi sakta hai aur nahi bhi.

Lactic acid, CH3-CH(OH)-COOH, ka aik chiral carbon CH3, H, OH aur COOH se jura hai. Teen dimension mein yeh do stereoisomers ki shakal mein hai jo aisi aaina shakalein hain jo aik doosre par nahi baithtin: enantiomers (Yunani enantio, yani ulta, se). Enantiomers ki tabeei aur kimiyai khasiyatein aik jaisi hain lekin yeh plane-polarised roshni ko barabar miqdar mein ulti simton mein ghumate hain, aur jaandaar nizamon mein mukhtalif asar kar sakte hain. (+) aur (-) shakalon ka 50:50 mixture optically inactive hai; yeh racemic mixture hai, jo naam se pehle (+/-) laga kar likha jata hai. Is tarah lactic acid (+)-lactic acid, (-)-lactic acid aur inactive racemic mixture ki shakal mein milta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: CH3-C*H(OH)-COOH, carbon 3, 2, 1 numbered aur carbon 2 par sitara (oopar OH, neeche H). Beech: (-) lactic acid, sitare wala C, CH3 oopar, HOOC neeche baen, H daen taraf hashed bond par aur OH neeche daen thos wedge par. Aik dashed khari aaina lakeer. Daen: (+) lactic acid, is ki aaina shakal: CH3 oopar, COOH neeche daen, H baen taraf hashed aur HO neeche baen wedge par.
blocks.caption: Lactic acid aur us ke do enantiomers, (-) aur (+) lactic acid (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sitara (*) chiral carbon dikhata hai: is par CH3, H, OH aur COOH, chaar mukhtalif groups hain. Thos wedge wala group dekhne wale ki taraf (aage) aur hashed wala peeche hai. (-) aur (+) lactic acid aik doosre ki aaina shakal hain, magar aik doosre par nahi baithte: yeh enantiomers hain. Dono barabar miqdar mein milein to racemic mixture (+/-) banta hai jo optically inactive hai.

Jin stereoisomers mein kam az kam do milte julte chiral carbons hon aur symmetry ka plane bhi ho woh optically inactive hain. Yeh plane molecule ko do aise hisson mein baant'ta hai jo aik doosre ki aaina shakal hain; har hissa polarised roshni ke plane ko ulti simt mein ghumata, is liye molecule ke andar hi gardishein khatam ho jati hain (internal compensation). Aise stereoisomers meso shakalein hain; meso-tartaric acid is ki mashhoor misal hai.

blocks.alt: Peela dabba. Tartaric acid ki do Fischer projections, 'Mirror' likhi dashed khari lakeer ke dono taraf: baen COOH, H-C-OH, H-C-OH, COOH; daen COOH, HO-C-H, HO-C-H, COOH. Dono ke beech se guzarti dashed pari lakeer par 'Plane of symmetry' likha hai. Neeche: '1 and 2 are Identical and represent meso form of tartaric acid'.
blocks.caption: Tartaric acid ki meso shakal (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono projections aaine ki do taraf hain, phir bhi aik hi molecule hain: daen wali ko kaghaz ke plane mein 180 darje ghumayein to baen wali ban jati hai. Pari dashed lakeer symmetry ka plane hai: oopar ka aadha neeche ke aadhe ki aaina shakal hai. Aik aadha roshni ko daen aur doosra utna hi baen ghumata hai, is liye meso-tartaric acid optically inactive hai (internal compensation).

blocks.title: Kitne optical isomers?
blocks.text: Optical isomers ki zyada se zyada tadaad 2^n hai, jahan n chiral carbon atoms ki tadaad hai. Agar do ya zyada chiral carbons milte julte hon to tadaad kam hoti hai (jaise tartaric acid, jis ki meso shakal hai).

blocks.prompt: Chiral ya achiral batayein: pencil, kitab, joota, cup, kaan, paon, anda, chamcha.
blocks.explanation: Chiral: joota, kaan aur paon (har aik ki baen aur daen shakal). Achiral: pencil, kitab (saada cheez ke taur par), cup, anda aur chamcha (har aik mein symmetry ka plane).

blocks.prompt: Khuli zanjeer wale glucose aur fructose mein kitne chiral carbons hain, aur kitne optical isomers mumkin hain? Kya meso shakal hai?
blocks.explanation: Glucose ke 4 chiral carbons (C2 se C5), is liye 2^4 = 16 optical isomers; fructose ke 3 (C3 se C5), is liye 2^3 = 8. Kisi ki meso shakal nahi, kyunke har zanjeer ke dono sire mukhtalif hain (aik sire par CHO ya C=O, doosre par CH2OH), is liye symmetry ka plane mumkin nahi.

items: Optical isomers plane-polarised roshni ghumate: (+) daen, (-) baen.
Chiral carbon: chaar mukhtalif groups; enantiomers aisi aaina shakalein jo aik doosre par na baithein.
Racemic mixture (+/-) aur meso shakalein optically inactive; zyada se zyada 2^n optical isomers.
